svg.title: Decision tree: accuracy vs max depth
svg.desc: Line chart of decision tree accuracy against max depth (2 to 10, then every 5 to 50). Training accuracy (black circles, solid line) climbs from about 0.85 at depth 2 to 1.0 by depth 25 and stays there. Test accuracy (blue triangles, dashed line) climbs to a peak of about 0.896 at depths 9 and 10, then falls and settles around 0.873. A dashed vertical line marks the optimal depth, 4: train 0.874, test 0.867.
svg.text: Decision tree: accuracy vs max depth
